vllm/attention/ops/triton_prefill_attent._fwd_kernel:
@triton.jit
def _fwd_kernel(
    Q,
    K,
    V,
    sm_scale,
    B_Start_Loc,
    B_Seqlen,
    Out,
    stride_qbs,
    stride_qh,
    stride_kbs,
    stride_kh,
    stride_vbs,
    stride_vh,
    stride_obs,
    stride_oh,
    kv_group_num: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_DMODEL: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
    IS_CAUSAL: tl.constexpr,
    SLIDING_WINDOW_Q: tl.constexpr,
    SLIDING_WINDOW_K: tl.constexpr,
    Lk: tl.constexpr,
):
    cur_batch = tl.program_id(0)
    cur_head = tl.program_id(1)
    start_m = tl.program_id(2)

    cur_kv_head = cur_head // kv_group_num

    cur_batch_seq_len = tl.load(B_Seqlen + cur_batch)
    cur_batch_start = tl.load(B_Start_Loc + cur_batch)

    # initialize offsets
    offs_m = start_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
    offs_n = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
    offs_d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_DMODEL)

    # mask for valid queries
    valid_m = offs_m < cur_batch_seq_len
    # global token indices
    global_m = cur_batch_start + offs_m
    # load Q: shape [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL]
    off_q = global_m[:, None] * stride_qbs + cur_head * stride_qh + offs_d[None, :]
    q = tl.load(Q + off_q, mask=valid_m[:, None] & (offs_d[None, :] < Lk), other=0.0)

    # initialize m_i, l_i, acc
    m_i = tl.full([BLOCK_M], float("-inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
    l_i = tl.full([BLOCK_M], 0.0, dtype=tl.float32)
    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL], dtype=tl.float32)

    # loop over key blocks
    start_n = 0
    while start_n < cur_batch_seq_len:
        # compute mask for valid keys in this block
        offs_n_cur = start_n + offs_n
        valid_n = offs_n_cur < cur_batch_seq_len
        global_n = cur_batch_start + offs_n_cur
        # load K: shape [BLOCK_DMODEL, BLOCK_N] (transposed)
        off_k = global_n[None, :] * stride_kbs + cur_kv_head * stride_kh + offs_d[:, None]
        k = tl.load(K + off_k, mask=valid_n[None, :] & (offs_d[:, None] < Lk), other=0.0)
        # load V: shape [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_DMODEL]
        off_v = global_n[:, None] * stride_vbs + cur_kv_head * stride_vh + offs_d[None, :]
        v = tl.load(V + off_v, mask=valid_n[:, None] & (offs_d[None, :] < Lk), other=0.0)

        # compute qk = q @ k, shape [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N]
        qk = tl.dot(q, k)
        qk *= sm_scale

        # apply masking
        pos_m = offs_m[:, None]
        pos_n = offs_n_cur[None, :]
        # mask invalid queries and keys
        qk = tl.where(valid_m[:, None], qk, float("-inf"))
        qk = tl.where(valid_n[None, :], qk, float("-inf"))
        # causal mask
        if IS_CAUSAL:
            qk = tl.where(pos_m >= pos_n, qk, float("-inf"))
        # sliding window masks
        if SLIDING_WINDOW_Q > 0:
            qk = tl.where(pos_m - pos_n <= SLIDING_WINDOW_Q, qk, float("-inf"))
        if SLIDING_WINDOW_K > 0:
            qk = tl.where(pos_n - pos_m <= SLIDING_WINDOW_K, qk, float("-inf"))

        # flash attention softmax update
        m_ij = tl.maximum(m_i, tl.max(qk, axis=1))
        p = tl.exp(qk - m_ij[:, None])
        l_ij = tl.sum(p, axis=1)
        alpha = tl.exp(m_i - m_ij)
        acc = acc * alpha[:, None]
        # update acc
        acc = tl.dot(p, v, acc=acc)
        # update m_i and l_i
        l_i = l_i * alpha + l_ij
        m_i = m_ij

        start_n += BLOCK_N

    # finalize output, avoid division by zero
    out = tl.where(l_i[:, None] == 0.0, 0.0, acc / l_i[:, None])
    off_o = global_m[:, None] * stride_obs + cur_head * stride_oh + offs_d[None, :]
    tl.store(Out + off_o, out, mask=valid_m[:, None] & (offs_d[None, :] < Lk))
